raw_text: Has anyone else seen this video of the Bollywood superstar endorsing a PM candidate? It's all over WhatsApp and Telegram. I ran it through a deepfake detector and the face-swap confidence score was 0.89. The lighting angles on the face are completely inconsistent with the room. This is clearly manipulated media being pushed before the election phase.
